title: Chipotle Crema
summary: Smoky, spicy sour cream for tacos. A starting point toward Rocket Taco's Rocket Sauce.

steps.title: Whisk
steps.text: Whisk the sour cream, 1 chipotle, 1 tsp adobo, the lime juice, and salt.

steps.title: Adjust
steps.text: Taste and add more chipotle or adobo for heat. Thin with milk if you want to drizzle.

steps.title: Rest
steps.text: Let it sit so the heat settles in; it builds a little as it rests.

notes: Rocket Taco lists its Rocket Sauce as a chipotle crema but doesn't publish the recipe. If yours tastes off from theirs, adjust toward what you remember (more garlic, more lime, a mayo base).
